reason: I already pay for Bitrix24 and I have it set up, even if it is slow. Switching to a company with 1 to 5 customers and no references is a risk for my shop, and $29 a month is real money on what I earn.
objection: They are brand new, nobody I know uses it, and the AI calls are not even built. Why would I move my clients to something unproven when my current CRM, although annoying, works?
would_change_my_mind: A shop owner I know in Tashkent showing me it running on his phone, plus a free first 2 months or a price near $10 a month.
